title: Asiad: PH batters blank Palestine to open campaign on high note
summary: The Philippines opened its 2026 Asian Games baseball campaign with a 12-0 rout of debutants Palestine on Monday at the Toyohashi Municipal Baseball Stadium in Aichi Prefecture, Japan.
